title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.22375v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the automation of scientific discovery. However, existing systems share a core limitation: they optimize ideas independently for either Quality or Diversity. This often results in closely related ideas or large sets of trivial, unsound, or unclear concepts. We instead argue that research ideation should be framed as a conjunction of Quality and Diversity objectives, i.e., a Quality-Diversity (QD) search. Accordingly, we introduce IDEAgent, a multi-agent framework that tracks idea evolution through lineages. We jointly drive Quality using multi-objective feedback for repair and refinement, while Diversity is achieved through lightweight sequential memory and explicit comparison against completed ideas, historical variants, and rejected proposals. translated_title: IDEAgent：面向科研想法生成的智能体化质量-多样性搜索
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已显著推动了科学发现的自动化进程。然而，现有系统存在一个共同的核心局限：它们要么独立地优化想法的质量，要么独立地优化想法的多样性。这常常导致产生的想法高度雷同，或得到大量琐碎、不严谨或不清晰的概念。我们转而主张，研究想法的生成应当被构建为质量与多样性两个目标的联合优化，即质量-多样性搜索。据此，我们提出了IDEAgent，一个通过“谱系”追踪想法演化过程的多智能体框架。我们利用多目标反馈驱动修复与精炼来提升质量，同时通过轻量级的顺序记忆以及与已完成想法、历史变体和被否决提案的显式比较来实现多样性。为评估这一联合目标，我们开发了Yield指标，用于计算满足预定义标准（摘要内容在此处被截断）的最大相互多样化想法集合。
tldr: 该论文提出IDEAgent多智能体框架，将科研想法生成建模为质量与多样性的联合搜索，通过谱系追踪、多目标反馈和记忆比较机制产出既高质量又相互多样的研究想法，并设计了Yield指标进行评估。
en_tdlr: IDEAgent is a multi-agent framework that formulates research idea generation as a joint Quality-Diversity search, using lineage tracking, multi-objective feedback, and memory-based explicit comparison to produce high-quality yet mutually diverse research ideas, evaluated by a new metric called Yield.
